title: Maestro flow point percentages accept integers only (NumberFormatException)
symptom: tapOn point: "38%,72.7%" in a raw flow keeps failing on retry and looks like a driver problem
cause: Maestro point coordinates accept only integer percentages, so 72.7 raises NumberFormatException. A wrapper that only retries hides the real error
fix: Read the last error line in maestro.log first (~/.maestro/tests/<timestamp>/maestro.log)
Round the percentage to an integer (72.7% → 73%)
Prefer app tap --at ratio coordinates over raw flows when possible (pro-launch rounds them)
